hero.title: Empyrean Beauty
hero.subtitle: Beauty Parlor
hero.intro: Meaning “heaven-like.” Twenty-three years of craft, sustainable product, and the most elevated chair in Montgomery County.

intro.heading: 23+ Years of Experience
intro.body: Empyrean Beauty is a beauty parlor in New Caney, TX. With over 23 years of experience and certifications, combined with an array of additional convenient services, we guarantee you the most elevated experience in the area.

booking.heading: Book your visit today.
booking.body: We do take walk-in appointments, but prefer booking with our online calendar. We can't wait to see you!

testimonials.quote: Thank you so much for going out of your way and helping me get this color. It is like a treasure in these difficult times.
testimonials.author: Sonia T.
